_note: Crewly cold email sequence for current Housecall Pro users. {{companyName}}, {{industry}} and {{website}} come from leads/instantly-import.csv. {{sendingAccountFirstName}} is filled by Instantly from the sending inbox. variants.label: A - booking page
variants.subject: {{companyName}}'s booking page
variants.body:
Hi {{companyName}} team,

I noticed you take online bookings through Housecall Pro.

I'm building Crewly, a Housecall Pro alternative for {{industry}} shops. It has the same plans at half the price. Essentials is $94/mo instead of $189. A real person answers the phone, and we move your customers, jobs and price book over for free.

The first 100 shops lock in that price for life. Want me to save you a spot?

{{sendingAccountFirstName}}
Founder, Crewly
POSTAL_ADDRESS

Not for you? Reply "no" and I won't email again.
